definition.name: Reaver Strike
definition.description: A strong attack that increases melee damage by $d. Activates on your next swing.

definition.name: Cinderbolt
definition.description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes $d Fire damage plus additional damage over time.

definition.name: Rimelance
definition.description: Launches a bolt of frost, causing $d Frost damage and slowing movement by 40%.

definition.name: Wicked Slash
definition.description: An instant strike for weapon damage plus $d. Awards 1 combo point.

definition.name: Goad
definition.description: Goads the target: your threat rises to match its most hated enemy and it is compelled to attack you for 3 sec.

definition.name: Holy Ground
definition.description: Consecrates the ground beneath you, searing nearby enemies for $d Holy damage every 2 sec for 10 sec.

definition.name: Whispered Prayer
definition.description: Heals a friendly target for $d.

definition.name: Consume
definition.description: Drains the target's life, transferring $d health to you each second for 5 sec.

definition.name: Harrow
definition.description: Strikes terror into the enemy, leaving it cowering for up to 8 sec. Any damage breaks the effect.

definition.name: Summon Emberkin
definition.description: Summons an Emberkin under the command of the Warlock. The Emberkin hurls Ashbolts at your enemies from afar. Summoning a new demon dismisses your current one. You may have one demon at a time.

definition.name: Armor Shear
definition.description: Sunders the target's armor, reducing it by $d% per application. Stacks up to 5 times. Generates a high amount of threat.

definition.name: Aetherburst
definition.description: A burst of Arcane energy hits all nearby enemies for $d Arcane damage.

definition.name: Dirt Nap
definition.description: Finishing move that causes $d.

definition.name: Low Blow
definition.description: Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts 1 sec longer per combo point.

definition.name: Oathbrand
definition.description: Fills you with Holy power for 30 sec, causing each of your melee swings to deal $d additional Holy damage. Unleash with Verdict.

definition.name: Verdict
definition.description: Unleashes your active Seal upon the enemy, consuming it to deal its judgement damage.

definition.name: Lunar Tempest
definition.description: Burns the enemy with moonfire for $d Arcane damage plus damage over time.

definition.name: Bruin Form
definition.description: Shapeshift into a bear: armor +90%, greatly increased attack power, your attacks build rage and generate 30% more threat. Cast again to return to caster form.

definition.name: Wolf Form
definition.description: Shapeshift into a wolf: agility rises with your level, attack power +8 plus 2 per level, your attacks use energy and combo points, and you generate 29% less threat. Cast again to return to caster form.

definition.name: Wildbloom
definition.description: Heals the target for $d over 12 sec.

definition.name: Gutting Strike
definition.description: A strong melee attack that increases damage by $d. Activates on your next swing.

definition.name: Craven Thrust
definition.description: Drive your dagger into the target's back for 150% weapon damage plus $d. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger. Awards 1 combo point.

definition.name: Eye Jab
definition.description: Strikes the target for $d damage, incapacitating it for 4 sec. Any damage breaks the effect. Awards 1 combo point.

definition.name: Venom Barb
definition.description: Stings the target, dealing $d Nature damage over 15 sec.

definition.name: Dirge of Decay
definition.description: A word of darkness causes $d Shadow damage over 18 sec.

definition.name: Lingering Grace
definition.description: Heals the target for $d over 15 sec.

definition.name: Psalm of Warding
definition.description: Shields the target, absorbing $d damage for 30 sec.

definition.name: Smite
definition.description: Smites the enemy for $d Holy damage.

definition.name: Mindfracture
definition.description: Blasts the target's mind for $d Shadow damage.

definition.name: Solemn Prayer
definition.description: A slow but powerful prayer that heals a friendly target for $d.

definition.name: Urgent Prayer
definition.description: A fast prayer that heals a friendly target for $d.

definition.name: Litany of Woe
definition.description: Assaults the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing $d Shadow damage each second for 3 sec.

definition.name: Arc Bolt
definition.description: Hurls a bolt of lightning for $d Nature damage.

definition.name: Mending Waters
definition.description: Heals a friendly target for $d.

definition.name: Earthen Jolt
definition.description: Instantly shocks the target with concussive force for $d Nature damage.

definition.name: Rime Jolt
definition.description: Instantly shocks the target with frost for $d Frost damage and slows its movement by 50% for 8 sec.

definition.name: Cinder Jolt
definition.description: Sears the target with fire for $d damage plus $o over 12 sec.

definition.name: Pyrebrand Weapon
definition.description: Imbues your weapon with elemental fire: each swing deals $d additional Fire damage for 5 min.

definition.name: Rimebound Weapon
definition.description: Imbues your weapon with biting frost: each swing deals $d additional damage for 5 min.

definition.name: Shadewolf
definition.description: Turns you into a Shadewolf, increasing movement speed by 40%. Cast again to return to normal form.

definition.name: Ancestral Strike
definition.description: Channels the storm through your weapon, instantly striking for weapon damage plus $d.

definition.name: Gloom Bolt
definition.description: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy for $d Shadow damage.

definition.name: Burning Pact
definition.description: Burns the enemy for $d Fire damage and an additional $o over 15 sec.

definition.name: Blackrot
definition.description: Corrupts the target, causing $d Shadow damage over 18 sec.

definition.name: Hard Bargain
definition.description: Converts $d health into $d mana.

definition.name: Hex of Anguish
definition.description: Curses the target with agony: $d Shadow damage over 24 sec.

definition.name: Sear
definition.description: Sears the enemy with agonizing fire for $d Fire damage. Quick to cast.

definition.name: Duskfire
definition.description: Instantly blasts the target with searing shadow for $d Shadow damage.

definition.name: Fiendhide
definition.description: Demonic skin increases your armor by $b for 30 min.

definition.name: Rain of Fire
definition.description: Calls a rain of fire onto the target area for 4 sec, burning enemies for $d Fire damage each second.

definition.name: Pyrelance
definition.description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes $d Fire damage plus additional damage over time.

definition.name: Flamestrike
definition.description: Calls down a burst of flame at the target area, dealing $d Fire damage to enemies caught in the blast. Can critically strike (one strike for the whole blast).

definition.name: Phoenix Trance
definition.description: Combust: for 10 sec your Fire spells always critically strike, including bolts already in flight. Off the global cooldown. These crits build Hot Streak like any other. (Fire signature)

definition.name: Overload
definition.description: Your next spell is amplified by 40% but costs 50% more mana. Lasts 10 sec. (Mage talent)

definition.name: Conflagrate
definition.description: Consumes your Burning Pact on the enemy to ignite them for $d Fire damage. (Destruction signature)

definition.name: Veinleech
definition.description: Siphons life from the enemy, causing $d Shadow damage over 30 sec and healing you for the damage done. (Affliction signature)

definition.name: Swiftmend
definition.description: Consumes a heal-over-time effect on a friendly target to heal them for $d. (Restoration signature)

definition.name: Wildbolt
definition.description: Hurls a bolt of nature energy for $d Nature damage.

definition.name: Wildmend
definition.description: Heals a friendly target for $d.

definition.name: Skyfall
definition.description: Calls down a bolt of stellar fire, causing $d Arcane damage.

definition.name: Gripping Roots
definition.description: Roots the target in place for up to 12 sec.

definition.name: Bonecrush
definition.description: A mauling attack that increases melee damage by $d and causes a high amount of threat. Activates on your next swing. Bruin Form only.

definition.name: Menace
definition.description: Menaces the target: your threat rises to match its most hated enemy and it is compelled to attack you for 3 sec. Bruin Form only.

definition.name: Craven Roar
definition.description: Demoralizes nearby enemies, reducing their attack power by 20 for 20 sec. Bruin Form only.

definition.name: Stalk
definition.description: Enter stealth while in Wolf Form, moving 50% slower. Cannot be used in combat.

definition.name: Flense
definition.description: A stealth opener that rakes the enemy for weapon damage plus $d and causes bleeding damage over 9 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Claw
definition.description: Claw the enemy for weapon damage plus $d. Awards 1 combo point. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Gorebite
definition.description: Finishing move that causes $d. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Sweeping Claws
definition.description: Sweep your claws through nearby enemies for $d damage. Causes extra threat. Bruin Form only.

definition.name: Second Bloom
definition.description: Heals a friendly target for $d and an additional amount over 21 sec.

definition.name: Oakhide
definition.description: Your skin hardens like bark, increasing armor by 150 for 15 sec.

definition.name: Primal Reflexes
definition.description: Your instincts sharpen, increasing your chance to dodge by 50% for 6 sec.

definition.name: Stoke
definition.description: Generates 20 rage instantly. Bruin Form only.

definition.name: Concuss
definition.description: Stuns the target for 2 sec. Bruin Form only.

definition.name: Witchlight
definition.description: Decreases the target's armor by $d% for 40 sec. Does not stack with Armor Shear.

definition.name: Slumber
definition.description: Forces the target into a deep sleep for up to 8 sec. Any damage will awaken it.

definition.name: Dash
definition.description: Sprint forward, increasing movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Slinkstrike
definition.description: A stealth opener that stuns the target for 2 sec. Awards 1 combo point. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Stinging Swarm
definition.description: The enemy is swarmed by insects, taking $d Nature damage over 12 sec.

definition.name: Wolfsblood
definition.description: Increases attack power by $b for $t sec. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Rip
definition.description: Finishing move that causes $d Bleed damage over 12 sec. Consumes combo points. Wolf Form only.

definition.name: Galeheart
definition.description: Calls a hurricane onto the target area for 6 sec, battering enemies for $d Nature damage each second.

definition.name: Headbutt
definition.description: Interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec. (Druid talent)

definition.name: Temporal Mend
definition.description: Draws an ally a moment forward in time, mending $d health as the body settles into its healthier future self. (Chronomancy signature)

definition.name: Temporal Echo
definition.description: Marks an ally with an echo of a healthier moment, mending $d health at once. For $t sec, part of the Arcane damage you deal is drawn back through the echo to heal them.

definition.name: Temporal Cascade
definition.description: Sends an echo cascading through your group: the target and up to four of their nearest allies are mended at once and each marked for $t sec, drawing part of the Arcane damage you deal back through their echoes to heal them. (Chronomancy)

definition.name: Rewind
definition.description: Sends an arcane wave through your group or raid, rewinding time to restore 30% of the damage each ally within 40 yards took over the last 5 seconds (up to 35% of their maximum health). Cannot be a critical effect. (Chronomancy)

definition.name: Temporal Barrier
definition.description: Shifts the target a heartbeat out of the present, a temporal shell absorbing $d damage for 10 sec before the timeline snaps back.

definition.name: Aether Surge
definition.description: Draws a surge of raw aether through the enemy for $d damage. Each cast leaves an Arcane Charge that raises your next Aether Surge's damage and cast speed (5% faster each) but sharply raises its mana cost, stacking up to 4; Aether Darts spends the charges. Each cast can also arm Aether Rush, making your next Aether Surge free and twice as fast to cast.

definition.name: Aether Darts
definition.description: Launches Aether Darts at the enemy, causing $d Arcane damage each second for 3 sec.

definition.name: Perfect Moment
definition.description: Seize your perfect moment: instantly gain 4 Arcane Charges, and for 10 sec Aether Darts does not consume them. (Chronomancer)

definition.name: Hourglass of Suspension
definition.description: Place a temporal hourglass at the selected location. Beneath an enemy, it suspends them for $e sec in PvE or $p sec in PvP and prevents all actions; damage breaks the effect. At your feet or beneath a group ally, it grants stasis for $t sec, prevents damage and actions, restores $h% of maximum health, and makes cooldowns recover $s% faster for you or $a% faster for an ally. On empty ground, the hourglass waits for $g sec and affects the first valid unit to step on it. The beneficial aura can be removed manually.

definition.name: Temporal Acceleration
definition.description: Accelerates the flow of time for your group or raid, increasing attack, casting, and channeling speed by 30% for 15 sec. Allies recently affected by Temporal Acceleration or Storm Chorus are too exhausted to benefit. (Chronomancy)
